name: mcp-my-site
description: MCP my site: make your website answer AI agents

paragraphs: Point it at your website and ChatGPT, Claude and any other MCP client can search and read it.

A command-line indexer crawls the site and builds a hybrid keyword and vector index. A small ASP.NET Core app serves that index as an MCP server with search and fetch tools, and as a JSON search API for the site's own search box. One site per server, built for sites under 1,000 pages.
features: Hybrid search. BM25 keyword search and vector search over embeddings, fused per query, with a
keyword-only fallback when the embedding provider is unavailable.
Works without a key. A keyword-only index needs no embeddings provider at all; switch to
hybrid search later with one setting and a rebuild.
